title: LayoutNode
description: Recursive split-tree describing a workspace layout. A node is either a leaf pane or a split that arranges child nodes horizontally or vertically. Enforces Principle V (Layout as a Persisted Tree): arbitrary, asymmetric trees are first-class and must round-trip losslessly.

pane.title: Pane
pane.description: A leaf that hosts a single terminal pane, referenced by paneId.

paneId.description: Stable id of the pane; maps to a Pane row and (optionally) a live session.

split.title: Split
split.description: An internal node dividing space among its children along one axis. sizes are percentages that sum to ~100 and align 1:1 with children.

direction.description: horizontal = children laid out left→right; vertical = top→bottom.

sizes.description: Percentage size of each child, index-aligned with children; length MUST equal children length.
